headline: Maui County Board of Ethics

meeting.summary: The Board of Ethics voted on two requests for ethics advice and met in a closed-door session.
meeting.recap: A county employee asked if her staff member may review a grantee's reports while the staff member's son works there.[[0:03:50]] She said the son is an adult and not a dependent.[[0:05:01]] The board's attorney said the rules define a financial interest as one held by the employee, a spouse, or dependent children.[[0:08:58]] A motion said the request raises no ethics issue.[[0:09:26]] The motion passed five to zero.[[0:13:03]] A new Maui Planning Commission member asked if he may take part in a case before the commission.[[0:13:36]] He said a lawyer for other parties raised concern about his seat on a community association board.[[0:13:54]] He said he sat out the November 26 meeting out of caution.[[0:15:24]] He said he has never been paid by the association.[[0:17:01]] A motion, as amended, said he may take part in the upcoming meeting.[[0:26:55]] All five members raised their hands in favor.[[0:27:56]] The board voted five to zero to meet in executive session (a closed-door meeting).[[0:31:33]] The next meeting is January 8 at 12:30.[[0:33:24]]
decided: The board voted to go into executive session (a closed-door meeting).
The chair reported the board voted to set one closed-session matter for an informal hearing.
The chair reported the board voted to decline review of another matter for lack of jurisdiction and refer it to another investigating body.
meeting.next: The board will meet next on January 8 at 12:30. One closed-session matter is set for an informal hearing.

moments.q: County employee explains her ethics question
